description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing a tree panel UI component using Ext JS framework, including features like saving/restoring tree state, handling expand/collapse events, and initializing the tree with configuration data.

classes.name: TreePanelState
classes.description: A class for managing the save and restore of tree panel state, including expand/collapse handling and persistence using local storage.

methods.name: TreePanelState.init
methods.description: Initializes the state by retrieving stored data from local storage.

methods.name: TreePanelState.saveState
methods.description: Saves the current tree state to local storage.

methods.name: TreePanelState.onExpand
methods.description: Handles node expansion, updating the stored state.

methods.name: TreePanelState.onCollapse
methods.description: Handles node collapse, updating the stored state.

methods.name: TreePanelState.restoreState
methods.description: Restores the tree to the last saved state or defaults.
